login.security_notice: Sign-in records the time, outcome, source IP, browser or device digest and session security identifiers for credential-attack prevention, abnormal-login review, single-session protection and incident investigation. Detailed history is retained for at least 366 days and then removed in controlled batches by a separate restricted account; IP is not proof of identity. See
